# Native capture: Flow refire with mutating and rejecting before trigger

A fresh 30-day scratch org was created from a campaign Dev Hub and the synthetic project deployed. Project Flow, action, trigger and guard sources are API 62; ceiling files are their API 67 variants. API 67 Flow/action/trigger/guard was deployed first and test classes at 62 and 67 run, then all four were redeployed at API 62 and the 62 class rerun. Two, three and 200 records enter an after-save Flow whose writes refire before- and after-update triggers. The before trigger mutates fields; a separate two-record case adds a synthetic error to the second input. A guarded nested update and overlength rejection are controls. Message predicates avoid volatile synthetic record IDs in platform error text. Observations are JSON assertion payloads with identifiers, email addresses and URLs scrubbed. Three fresh scratch orgs were deleted and verified Deleted: an initial capture had volatile messages, a portable retry was rejected at deployment because of a Boolean/string typo, and this corrected retry supplied the rows.
